svg.title: Exact four-level Haar transfer matrix
svg.desc: A 16 by 16 matrix for W H W inverse. Rows are output wavelet coordinates, columns are input wavelet coordinates, ordered global mean then levels four through one. Teal is positive, ochre negative, grey zero. Each nonzero cell is labeled with its exact rational value.
svg.text: FIR transfer in four-level Haar coordinates
16 × 16 exact coefficients · 56 nonzero · W H W⁻¹
Averaging-normalized Haar basis · no approximation · finite circular boundary
